critique: The render has a strong Flight Plasma look: dense magenta/purple particle ribbons, luminous white-hot intersections, black background, and broad flowing fractal contours. However, frames 1 and 4 are visually identical, so the essential animated plasma/flight motion is absent. The form also reads slightly over-bright in the central crossing areas, reducing some of the fine particle definition.

suggestions.why: Drive Fractal Evolution continuously so the plasma surface visibly evolves and travels between rendered frames instead of remaining static.
